verdict.rationale: Oneleet's docs show a compliance platform with policy templates, framework management (add/remove frameworks like SOC 2), evidence automation via Fieldwork AI agents, integrations for continuous monitoring, and pentest bundled into audits — consistent with running a SOC 2 program end to end. However, the evidence pack never explicitly names Type I vs Type II support, nor explicitly lists Trust Services Criteria (security, availability, confidentiality, etc.) mapped to controls. missing for 10: explicit Type I/Type II distinction and workflow, explicit Trust Services Criteria control mapping, and independent/hands-on corroboration of successful SOC 2 completion.
